        inline.tokens.append({'type': 'text', 'raw': text, 'children': None})

    # Sort by length (longest first) to handle overlapping abbreviations
    keys = sorted(ref_abbrs.keys(), key=len, reverse=True)
    pattern = r'(?<!\w)(' + '|'.join(re.escape(key) for key in keys) + r')(?!\w)'
